runList.comment: Little better now! ;)
inches from 1'40"xx -should probably grab it myself before PLK takes it first!
Insane Run with almost Perfektion for Sub 1'41
Someone will beat this, but this No-Skip WR is solid
No Skip
Lap one can be found here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tyfo3mSFI-0

Should still have another 10ms to cut.



It probably won't be me that does it.



Pattern:



- lap 1, boost off start, delay ~0.1ms after boost end, boost 2 in pit.
- like in lap 4, short jump, land early, then boost around corner to the jump pad area.

- neutral stick on jump zone, cut as far left as possible for third jump to cross pit.  wait until fully landed, then boost across the rough

- clean corner cut and boost



lap 2/3 - nag turn after jump 1.  do same jump cut as lap 1 off of jump pad area, wait to boost until fully landed, clean corner cut.



lap 4 - seen above.  same as lap 1, but no pit boost.  Even a perfect run will still likely go power down at the very end.
